title: Walk Along John to Kansas (10-bar As)
author: Sue Rosen
problems: Row 7 "neighbors start a hey - rights on ends, lefts in center - until partners meet the second time (neighbors right, robins left, partners right, larks left, neighbors right, robins left) - robins catch left hands" isn't drawn yet.
Row 8 "form an ocean wave & balance - robins by left hands and partners by right hands" can't start from where the dancers are: The robins cannot join left hands facing the way they do.
The progression after row 10 "walk forward to next neighbors" doesn't work out: Couples 1 and 2 have not passed each other yet.

Row 3 "pass through to an ocean wave & balance - robins by left in the center, partners by right on the sides" can't start from where the dancers are: The robins cannot join left hands facing the way they do.
